articles.text: JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Gèwèi hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: Do you have any more questions?

MĚIGUÓ JÌZHĚ: Yǒu yíge hěn xiǎode wèntí, wǒ xiǎng zuìjìn jǐjiè jiāoyìhuì kànqilai dōu gǎode hěn bú cuò, wàiguó shāngren hěn shǎo yǒu kōngshǒu huíqùde, búguò yǒu xiē qíngxing nǐmen néng bu néng gǎide kuài yìdiǎnr ne?

AMERICAN REPORTER: One small question. The last few trade fairs have all looked very successful. Foreign businessmen have rarely gone home empty-handed. But couldn't you change certain things a little faster?
JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Dāngrán, wàishāngmen tíchūláide jiànyì wǒmen zǒngshi yào kǎolǜde.
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: Of course, we always consider suggestions from foreign businessmen.
JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Guǎngjiāohuìde mùdì jiù shi yào fánróng jìnchūkǒu màoyì ma!
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: The purpose of holding the Guǎngzhōu Trade Fair is to make foreign trade prosper!

MĚIGUÓ JÌZHĚ: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yíge jiànyì. Nǐmende píjiǔ píngzi kě bu kěyi gǎi xiǎo yìdiǎnr ne? Wǒmen hěn xǐhuan Zhōngguó chūkǒude píjiǔ, kěshi hěn bù xǐhuan nèixiē xiàng jiàngyóupíng yíyàngde dà píngzi. Yùnqilai bù fāngbian. Érqiě Xīngqīliù, Xīngqītiān wǒmen xǐhuan chūqu lǚxíng, xiǎo píng píjiǔ hēwán jiù rēng, duōme fāngbian.

AMERICAN REPORTER: I just have one suggestion. Could you make your beer bottles smaller? We like the beer that China exports, but we don't like those big bottles that look like soy sauce bottles. They're difficult to ship. Besides, on weekends we like to go out on trips. It's so convenient to have small bottles which you can throw out when you're finished.

JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Xièxie ni. Zhèige jiànyì tíde hěn hǎo. Shàngcì Xiānggǎng màoyì dàibiǎotuán lái zhèlide shíhou yǐjīng tíchulai le. Dāi huǐr wǒmen jiù kěyi qǐng gèwèi kàn yíxiàr wǒmende xiǎo píng píjiǔ, búguò zhèizhǒng píjiǔ mùqián hái bù néng dà guīmó shēngchǎn, wǒmende shèbèi hái yǒu hěn duō xiànzhì.

DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: Thank you. That's a very good suggestion. It was already made by a trade delegation from Hong Kong when they came here. Later, we can show you our smaller-bottle beer, but at present this kind of beer cannot yet be produced on a large scale. Our equipment still has many limitations.
MĚIGUÓ JÌZHĚ: Yěxǔ zài zhèifāngmiàn wǒmen Měiguó gōngsī kěyi hé Zhōngguó fāngmiàn hézuò, tígāo bāozhuāngde xiàolǜ.
AMERICAN REPORTER: Perhaps some of our American companies might be able to cooperate with China in this area and raise your bottling efficiency.
JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Zhèige wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, wǒmen děi yánjiū yánjiū, wǒ xīwang bù jiǔ, wǒmen jiù kěyi gěi nǐ yíge mǎnyìde huídá.
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: This is a rather complicated question which we will have to look into. I hope that we will be able to give you a satisfactory answer before long.
MĚIGUÓ JÌZHĚ: Xièxie ni.
AMERICAN REPORTER: Thank you.
JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Hái yǒu shénme biéde wèntí ma?
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: Any more questions?
MĚIGUÓ JÌZHĚ: Xiànzài méiyǒu le.
AMERICAN REPORTER: No.
JIĀOYÌHUÌ ZHǓRÈN: Hǎo, nàme wǒmende zhāodàihuì jiù kāi dào zhèli, wǒ yào xièxie gèwèi xīnwénjiè péngyoude bāngzhù hé jiànyì, xièxie dàjiā.
DIRECTOR OF THE TRADE FAIR: All right, then we'll end the press conference here. I'd like to thank all of you friends from the press for your help and suggestions, and thank all of you.
